criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slide 5 is strongest, slide 1 clean, slide 9 well lit but generic. Slides 2, 4, 6 and 8 fall to the 4 to 6 descriptors, slide 3's bays read as stickers, slide 7's furrows as corduroy.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One dusk to night world and one key. The two top-down reliefs cut out of the road world, slide 3's orange a second signal colour.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Slide 5's headline drops up to, the caption's first line drops Soluna says, slide 8's majority ownership rested on c8's text alone.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where, what it rests on and what is soft all land. The deciding body and any date are missing, and behind the meter is never explained.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The turn at 5 sets up 6. Slide 7 is the cuttable frame, slide 3 delays the turn.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, relays the company more than it reports, Texas texture only in the art.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The cover's move is fresh. lastLight again, the transformer bay of no. 60, the staked pasture, the courthouse close, squares drawn to area.

one_sentence_fix: Name the body that votes on a Texas county tax abatement and its next meeting from a primary source.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat beige card on seamed tiles, the square a dot, the pin's shadow a smear.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One continuous red earth height field off all four edges, Briscoe with the Caprock escarpment as a lit wall.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The transformer reads as clay and the pasture across the road is an unreadable strip.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back from the substation gate looking east so the road splits the lower third and the fence stands lit at 30 percent of the width.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The chain is floating rings and the 51/49 split is invisible.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One wrapped run of 8 to 10 heavy links with the padlock under the seam.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The near pasture sits in lavender mid-grey and the substation is a dim silhouette.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Light pool on the yard, the near pasture to near black, only stake tops and flagging rim-lit.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Bay plates pasted over the wall and an empty grass band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Glow behind the louvre slats and a crop with the hall in the lower third.
